legend: Mike wants to prepare for IMO but he doesn't know geometry, so his teacher gave him an interesting geometry problem. Let's define f([l, r]) = r - l + 1 to be the number of integer points in the segment [l, r] with l ≤ r (say that ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1615b40d21388b3b07e9da1685903cf7bb98b938.png)). You are given two integers n and k and n closed intervals [li, ri] on OX axis and you have to find:
In other words, you should find the sum of the number of integer points in the intersection of any k of the segments.
As the answer may be very large, output it modulo 1000000007 (109 + 7).
Mike can't solve this problem so he needs your help. You will help him, won't you?
input: The first line contains two integers n and k (1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 200 000) — the number of segments and the number of segments in intersection groups respectively.
Then n lines follow, the i-th line contains two integers li, ri ( - 109 ≤ li ≤ ri ≤ 109), describing i-th segment bounds.
output: Print one integer number — the answer to Mike's problem modulo 1000000007 (109 + 7) in the only line.

legend.ai: Mike 想为 IMO 做准备，但他不会几何，因此他的老师给了他一道有趣的几何题。定义 f([l, r]) = r - l + 1，表示满足 l ≤ r 的线段 [l, r] 中整数点的数量(记作 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1615b40d21388b3b07e9da1685903cf7bb98b938.png))。给定两个整数 n 和 k，以及 OX 轴上的 n 个闭区间 [li, ri]，你需要求出：
换句话说，你需要求任意 k 个线段的交集中的整数点数量之和。
由于答案可能非常大，请将其对 1000000007（10^9 + 7）取模后输出。
Mike 无法解决这道题，所以他需要你的帮助。你会帮助他，对吧？

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 n 和 k（1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 200 000），分别表示线段的数量以及交集组中线段的数量。
接下来有 n 行，第 i 行包含两个整数 li、ri（-109 ≤ li ≤ ri ≤ 109），表示第 i 个线段的边界。

output.ai: 仅在一行中输出一个整数，即 Mike 的问题的答案对 1000000007（109 + 7）取模后的结果。
